verdict.rationale: The evidence implies iterative re-review that tracks resolution status. Greptile distinguishes "unaddressed" from addressed comments, and Greplooping iterates fixes until "zero unresolved comments". Review triggers are configurable, and noise control skips repetitive feedback. However, nothing explicitly says that pushing new commits automatically starts an incremental re-review scoped to the new diff, or that old comments are not re-posted. Missing for 10: explicit docs that a push triggers a re-review, incremental diff-only scope, documented suppression of duplicate comments and auto-resolution of fixed ones, independent hands-on corroboration.
